entities.summary: Phillip Buford Davidson Jr. was an American lieutenant general who served in World War II, the Korean War, and the Vietnam War. Davidson was also one of the two men who is credited for creating the modern Intelligence Cycle while serving as a staffer at United States Army Command and General Staff College, alongside Robert R. Glass.
